text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not
verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- The (Spanish) government goes ahead, backed by IU, with a confiscatory "soccer law".
- The two decoders are compatible
- The Atapuerca fossils reveal a new human species, Homo predecessor.
EL MUNDO
- Popular party approves antimonopoly soccer law, backed by IU and PNV.
- 500 days without (kidnapped) Ortega Lara
- Spanish scientists find Homo Predecessor.
- Political crisis in Germany increases uncertainty over Euro and bring new falls in the bourse
- Milan's Inter soccer club confirmed it made an offer to Ronaldo
DIARIO 16
- (IU's leader) Anguita votes Popular party
ABC
- Soccer law: Cascos defeats Gonzalez, Pujol, Polanco and Asensio.
CINCO DIAS
- Popular party enters in soccer by law
- Germany's crisis took off another 1.6 percent from the bourse
- Economists now believe (economy minister) Rato's forecasts of three percent growth rate.
EXPANSION
- Stock market commission CNMV will investigate the change in payments for Repsol's board.
- Bourse falls another 1.54 percent amid EMU uncertainties
- Economy Ministry target's Tabacalera contracts with Philip Morris and Reynolds.
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Kohl-Bundesbank duel threatens euro delay
- Canal Satelite and Via Digital start to get closer in Brussels
- The avdance of the left wing in France strengthens doubts over UEM
- Telefonica's Villalonga shares power with Revuelta
